## 6 · Even as the Enemy Blasts, God Builds
Sanballat's favorite weapon was rumor.

He answered cleanly, then prayed, and kept laying brick.

**Sticky lesson:** when rumors try to pull you off the wall, deny the lie, pray, and finish the work.
:::callout
**VERSE · Nehemiah 6:9**
"For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands." — Nehemiah 6:9
:::
